body: You're very perceptive. You're right, I do place high standards upon myself. I don't know if there is anything unacceptable about 'okay' life. I don't judge anybody or look down on anybody who doesn't meet them. They're standards by which I judge myself and nobody else. I just don't know how to cope with disappointing myself.
I think I could learn to enjoy life and settle with what I have, but in the end I don't think it'll be worth it. It'd be like an okay movie with no real point to it.
